references.text: Describes the same boundary from the perspective of the tribe of Benjamin and mentions Kiriath-Jearim (Baalah) as a border point.
Mentions Kiriath-Jearim as one of the cities in the hill country of Judah, the same place called Baalah in verse 9.
Kiriath-Jearim is mentioned as one of the Gibeonites' cities, the same place referred to in the boundary description.
Kiriath-Jearim is mentioned in connection with the border of Judah, where the ark of the covenant was later kept.
Kiriath-Jearim (Baalah) was the place from which the ark of the covenant was brought, the same place mentioned in the boundary description.
Kiriath-Jearim was the place where the ark of the covenant was kept for twenty years, the same city called Baalah in the boundary description.
Kiriath-Jearim (Baalah) is mentioned when David brings the ark of the covenant, the same place as in Judah's boundary description.
